answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the dune of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The voyage holds work receipts rather than names, so the horizon of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, split across independent auditors, idle agents bleed standing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
